instrument_en: Multidimensional Hope in Counseling and Psychotherapy Scale — Turkish reduced 24-item form
scales: Four empirically retained Turkish factors of multidimensional hope in psychotherapy; exact adapted subscale wording/item mappings not yet crosschecked
research_provenance: Ercan M, Ercan FZ, 2026-04-13; original 34-item MHCPS reduced to 24; two stages N303+157 (N460).
language_evidence: TR-TR validated shortened adaptation; no RU/ES translation
target_population: Therapy clients in Türkiye; ages >18 in TOAD
commercial_digital_rights: Original developer Denise Larsen requests permission; Turkish adaptation authors require study-use permission; commercial digital use unlicensed

instrument_en: Real Relationship Inventory — Therapist Form Turkish 19-item adaptation
research_provenance: Tatarhan M, Erdem A, Erdem S, published online 2026-06-09; N420 mental health professionals, original 24 reduced by 5.
language_evidence: TR-TR therapist-rated validated adaptation; not patient self-report; no RU/ES translation
target_population: Mental health professionals / therapists in Türkiye
commercial_digital_rights: Original RRI rights and Turkish translated electronic commercial use permission unconfirmed

instrument_en: Brief Experiential Avoidance Questionnaire — Turkish validated adaptation
research_provenance: Gerdan G, Gürlük YO, 2026-01-31, N356 adults 18-64; ESEM original one-factor replicated; alpha .889; omega .892.
language_evidence: TR-TR respondent language validated; original 15 items, final Turkish retained count pending primary questionnaire review
commercial_digital_rights: Publisher author copy CC BY-NC-ND is not commercial permission to reproduce questionnaire items; original and translated-rights clearance pending
